credit_metrics.text: EBITDA declined by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}} and operating profit by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}, with write-offs on the abandoned third runway project and higher personnel expenses under collective wage agreements weighing on the result.
Total debt was stable at {{total_debt@FY2025}}, so gross leverage held at {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, a change of {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} over the year.
FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, and free cash flow dropped by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} as capital spending absorbed more of the cash generated.
Capex intensity increased by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, against {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} in FY2024.

liquidity_funding.text: The group's debt is small and stable, so refinancing risk is limited and the funding base rests on internally generated cash rather than on committed facilities.
Undrawn committed facilities and cash-like balances are not disclosed in the fact base for FY2025, so the liquidity buffer cannot be sized against revenue.
Customer prepayments are not disclosed for FY2025, so the share of the cash position that reflects advance ticket sales cannot be assessed.

peer_positioning.text: Flughafen Wien sits in the middle of the airport group on EBITDA margin, at {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}).
Gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} is the lowest of the group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}), well below the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}, the one metric where the group spends more heavily than its peers.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}} and FFO by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, so the buffer against a heavier investment programme is thinner.
Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Margins: the EBITDA margin fell by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, in line with the peer median, as write-offs and wage-driven personnel costs weighed on earnings.
Disclosure: undrawn committed facilities and cash-like balances are not available for FY2025, so the liquidity cushion cannot be measured against revenue.
